query.description: Full-text search query applied to entries.

locale.description: Locale used when reading entry fields.

include.description: Number of linked content levels to include.

order.description: Order content types by field, for example sys.createdAt.

content_types.activate.title: Activate Content Type
content_types.activate.description: Activates (publishes) a content type in Contentful. Use this to make a content type available for creating entries. Requires the current version number for optimistic locking.

assets.archive.title: Archive Asset
assets.archive.description: Tool to archive an asset in Contentful. Use when you need to archive an asset to remove it from active use without deleting it permanently.

version.description: Current asset version sent as X-Contentful-Version.

entries.archive.title: Archive Entry
entries.archive.description: Tool to archive an entry in Contentful. Use when you need to move an entry to archived status. The entry must not be currently published, and you may need to provide the X-Contentful-Version header matching the entry's current version.

version.description: Current entry version sent as X-Contentful-Version.

releases.archive.title: Archive Release
releases.archive.description: Tool to archive a release in Contentful. Use when you need to lock a release to prevent modifications. An archived release cannot be edited until unarchived. Requires the current version number for optimistic locking.

app_definitions.keys.create.title: Create App Signing Key
app_definitions.keys.create.description: Tool to generate an app signing key for a Contentful app definition. Use when you need to create cryptographic keys for app authentication. Either provide generate=true to let Contentful create a key pair (returns private key), or provide a pre-generated public key in JWK format.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Create App Signing Key.

appDefinitionId.description: appDefinitionId for Create App Signing Key.

generate.description: When true, Contentful generates the signing key pair.

content_types.create.title: Create Content Type
content_types.create.description: Tool to create a new content type in a Contentful environment. Use when you need to define a new content structure with custom fields. Content types define the schema for entries.

fields.description: Field definitions for the content type (max 50).

displayField.description: Field id used as the entry title.

entries.tasks.create.title: Create Entry Task
entries.tasks.create.description: Tool to create a task on a Contentful entry. Use when you need to create workflow tasks for collaboration on entries. Tasks can be assigned to users and are used for managing content review and approval workflows.

assignedTo.description: User link assigned to the task.

environments.create.title: Create Environment
environments.create.description: Tool to create a new environment within a Contentful space. Use when you need to set up a new environment for content management, such as staging or production. Optionally clone from an existing source environment.

environmentId.description: ID of the environment to create (CMA path id).

locales.create.title: Create Locale
locales.create.description: Tool to create a new locale in a Contentful space environment. Use when you need to add support for a new language or regional variation to your content. Locales enable multi-language content management by defining which languages are available for translation. Only one locale can be set as the default locale per environment.

app_definitions.access_grants.create.title: Create App Access Grant
app_definitions.access_grants.create.description: Creates an access grant for an app definition to allow organizations to install the app. Use when you need to grant installation permissions for an app to specific organizations or all organizations (marketplace apps).

organizationId.description: organizationId for Create App Access Grant.

appDefinitionId.description: appDefinitionId for Create App Access Grant.

granteeId.description: Organization id to grant, or all.

app_definitions.create.title: Create Organizations App Definitions
app_definitions.create.description: Tool to create a new app definition in a Contentful organization. Use when you need to register a new app that can be installed into space environments.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Create Organizations App Definitions.

src.description: URL of the app HTML document.

locations.description: App locations inside the Contentful web app.

app_definitions.actions.create.title: Create App Definition Action
app_definitions.actions.create.description: Tool to create an action for a Contentful app definition. Use when you need to define actions that your app can perform, such as endpoint invocations or function calls.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Create App Definition Action.

appDefinitionId.description: appDefinitionId for Create App Definition Action.

type.description: Action type: endpoint, function, or function-invocation.

organizations.invitations.create.title: Create Organization Invitation
organizations.invitations.create.description: Create an invitation to an organization in Contentful (alpha feature). Use this to invite new users to join an organization with a specified role.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Create Organization Invitation.

role.description: Invitation role: member, developer, admin, or owner.

organizations.security_contacts.create.title: Create Organizations Security Contacts
organizations.security_contacts.create.description: Creates a security contact for a specific organization. Use when you need to add an email address to receive security notifications for the organization.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Create Organizations Security Contacts.

taxonomy.concepts.create.title: Create Organizations Taxonomy Concepts
taxonomy.concepts.create.description: Tool to create a new taxonomy concept in a Contentful organization. Use when you need to add a concept for classifying and organizing content within an organization's taxonomy.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Create Organizations Taxonomy Concepts.

hiddenLabels.description: Hidden search labels keyed by locale.

taxonomy.concept_schemes.create.title: Create Organizations Taxonomy Concept Schemes
taxonomy.concept_schemes.create.description: Tool to create a new taxonomy concept scheme in an organization. Use when you need to establish a new taxonomy structure or classification system for organizing content.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Create Organizations Taxonomy Concept Schemes.

releases.create.title: Create Release
releases.create.description: Tool to create a new release in Contentful. Use when you need to group entries and assets into a release for coordinated publishing or tracking. Requires at least one entity to be specified.

spaces.create.title: Create Space
spaces.create.description: Creates a new space in Contentful. A space is a container for all content types, entries, and assets. Use this action when you need to set up a new workspace for content management. Each space is isolated and has its own API keys and environments.

organizationId.description: Organization sent as X-Contentful-Organization.

defaultLocale.description: Default locale code for the space.

api_keys.create.title: Create Delivery API Key
api_keys.create.description: Tool to create a new Delivery API key for a Contentful space. Use when you need to generate new API credentials for accessing content delivery. The created key provides access to specified environments within the space.

spaceId.description: spaceId for Create Delivery API Key.

environments.description: Environment links this key can access.

assets.create.title: Create Asset
assets.create.description: Tool to create a new asset in a Contentful space environment. Use when you need to upload files like images, videos, or documents. After creation, the asset must be processed before it's available, and you may need to publish it to make it publicly accessible.

fields.description: Localized asset fields including file and title.

metadata.description: Optional asset metadata such as tags.

entries.create.title: Create Entry
entries.create.description: Tool to create a new entry in a Contentful space environment. Use when you need to add new content entries. Requires specifying the content type ID via X-Contentful-Content-Type header, and providing fields organized by locale.

contentTypeId.description: Content type id sent as X-Contentful-Content-Type.

fields.description: Localized entry fields keyed by field id then locale.

entries.comments.create.title: Create Entry Comment
entries.comments.create.description: Tool to create a comment on an entry in Contentful. Use when you need to add a comment to a specific entry. Returns the created comment with status 'active' by default.

extensions.create.title: Create Extension
extensions.create.description: Tool to create a new UI extension within a Contentful space and environment. Use when you need to add custom field editors or sidebar widgets to enhance content editing capabilities.

scheduled_actions.create.title: Create Scheduled Action
scheduled_actions.create.description: Tool to create a scheduled action for publishing or unpublishing entries/assets in Contentful. Use when you need to schedule an automatic publish or unpublish operation at a specific future time.

entity.description: Entry or asset link to act on.

environment.description: Environment link where the action runs.

webhooks.create.title: Create Webhook
webhooks.create.description: Create a new webhook in a Contentful space to receive real-time notifications about content changes. Use this action when you need to set up automated workflows that respond to events like entry creation, publishing, or asset updates. Webhooks send POST requests to your specified URL when matching events occur.

url.description: HTTPS URL that receives webhook POSTs.

topics.description: Event topics that trigger the webhook.

headers.description: Custom headers included on webhook requests.

assets.delete.title: Delete Asset
assets.delete.description: Deletes an asset by ID from a Contentful environment. Use this when you need to permanently remove an asset. Note: If Contentful rejects deletion for published or archived assets, you must unpublish first using the appropriate CMA endpoints.

content_types.delete.title: Delete Content Type
content_types.delete.description: Deletes a content type by ID from a Contentful environment. Use this when you need to permanently remove a content type. Note: Content types must be unpublished before deletion if they are published, and must have no associated entries.

entries.delete.title: Delete Entry
entries.delete.description: Deletes an entry by ID from a Contentful environment. Use this when you need to permanently remove an entry. Note: If Contentful rejects deletion for published or archived entries, you must unpublish or unarchive first using the appropriate CMA endpoints.

environments.delete.title: Delete Environment
environments.delete.description: Deletes an environment by ID from a Contentful space. Use this when you need to permanently remove an environment. Note: You cannot delete the 'master' environment or an environment with active aliases.

extensions.delete.title: Delete Extension
extensions.delete.description: Deletes an extension by ID from a Contentful environment. Use this when you need to permanently remove an extension.

locales.delete.title: Delete Locale
locales.delete.description: Deletes a locale by ID from a Contentful environment. Use this when you need to permanently remove a locale. This action is irreversible — the locale cannot be recovered once removed. Note: You cannot delete the default locale for an environment.

app_definitions.event_subscriptions.dele.title: Delete App Event Subscription
app_definitions.event_subscriptions.dele.description: Deletes an app event subscription from a Contentful organization. Use this when you need to remove event subscriptions from an app definition.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Delete App Event Subscription.

appDefinitionId.description: appDefinitionId for Delete App Event Subscription.

app_definitions.details.delete.title: Delete App Definition Details
app_definitions.details.delete.description: Tool to delete app definition details for an organization in Contentful. Use when you need to remove app definition details from an organization.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Delete App Definition Details.

appDefinitionId.description: appDefinitionId for Delete App Definition Details.

app_definitions.keys.delete.title: Delete App Key
app_definitions.keys.delete.description: Tool to delete an app key from an app definition in a Contentful organization. Use when you need to permanently remove an app key.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Delete App Key.

appDefinitionId.description: appDefinitionId for Delete App Key.

app_definitions.signing_secret.delete.title: Delete App Definition Signing Secret
app_definitions.signing_secret.delete.description: Tool to remove the current app signing secret from an app definition. Use when you need to delete an existing signing secret for security or rotation purposes.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Delete App Definition Signing Secret.

appDefinitionId.description: appDefinitionId for Delete App Definition Signing Secret.

organizations.security_contacts.delete.title: Delete Organization Security Contact
organizations.security_contacts.delete.description: Deletes a security contact from a Contentful organization. Use this when you need to remove a security contact from an organization.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Delete Organization Security Contact.

contactId.description: contactId for Delete Organization Security Contact.

releases.delete.title: Delete Release
releases.delete.description: Deletes a release by ID from a Contentful environment. Use this when you need to permanently remove a release.

scheduled_actions.delete.title: Delete Scheduled Action
scheduled_actions.delete.description: Cancels a scheduled action by ID in Contentful. Use this when you need to cancel a scheduled publish, unpublish, or other scheduled operation.

space_memberships.delete.title: Delete Space Membership
space_memberships.delete.description: Deletes a space membership by ID from a Contentful space. Use this when you need to remove a user's access to a space.

api_keys.delete.title: Delete Delivery API Key
api_keys.delete.description: Tool to delete a single Delivery API key from a Contentful space. Use when you need to permanently remove an API key. This action is useful for revoking access credentials when they are no longer needed or have been compromised.

spaceId.description: spaceId for Delete Delivery API Key.

apiKeyId.description: apiKeyId for Delete Delivery API Key.

version.description: API key version sent as X-Contentful-Version.

uploads.delete.title: Delete Spaces Upload
uploads.delete.description: Deletes an upload by ID from a Contentful space. Use this when you need to permanently remove an upload. Note: This operation uses the upload.contentful.com base URL instead of the standard API URL.

tags.delete.title: Delete Tag
tags.delete.description: Deletes a tag by ID from a Contentful environment. Use this when you need to permanently remove a tag.

webhooks.delete.title: Delete Webhook
webhooks.delete.description: Deletes a webhook definition by ID from a Contentful space. Use this action when you need to permanently remove a webhook configuration. This action is irreversible — the webhook cannot be recovered once removed.

app_definitions.bundles.get.title: Get App Bundle
app_definitions.bundles.get.description: Retrieves details of a specific app bundle by its ID. Use this to get information about an app bundle including its files, metadata, and associated app definition within a Contentful organization.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Get App Bundle.

appDefinitionId.description: appDefinitionId for Get App Bundle.

app_definitions.get.title: Get App Definition
app_definitions.get.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific app definition by its ID. Use when you need information about an app definition in an organization.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Get App Definition.

appDefinitionId.description: appDefinitionId for Get App Definition.

assets.get.title: Get Asset
assets.get.description: Tool to retrieve a single asset from a Contentful environment by its ID. Use when you need to get details about a specific asset including its file information, metadata, and publication status.

content_types.snapshots.get.title: Get Content Type Snapshot
content_types.snapshots.get.description: Tool to retrieve a snapshot of a content type by snapshot ID. Use when you need to view the state of a content type at a specific point in time. Snapshots are only available for content types in the master environment.

spaceId.description: spaceId for Get Content Type Snapshot.

contentTypeId.description: contentTypeId for Get Content Type Snapshot.

snapshotId.description: snapshotId for Get Content Type Snapshot.

content_types.snapshots.list.title: Get Content Type Snapshots
content_types.snapshots.list.description: Tool to get all snapshots of a content type in Contentful. Use when you need to retrieve the history of changes made to a content type structure.

spaceId.description: spaceId for Get Content Type Snapshots.

environmentId.description: environmentId for Get Content Type Snapshots.

contentTypeId.description: contentTypeId for Get Content Type Snapshots.

editor_interfaces.get.title: Get Editor Interface
editor_interfaces.get.description: Tool to retrieve the editor interface configuration for a content type. Use when you need to see how fields are configured in the Contentful UI. The editor interface is automatically created when a content type is first activated.

entries.get.title: Get Entry
entries.get.description: Tool to retrieve a single entry from a Contentful space environment by its ID. Use this action when you need to get details about a specific entry including its content, metadata, and publication status. Returns all localized and unpublished content from the Content Management API.

entries.comments.get.title: Get Entry Comment
entries.comments.get.description: Tool to retrieve a specific comment from an entry in Contentful. Use when you need to get details of a comment including its body, status, author, and metadata.

entries.references.get.title: Get Entry References
entries.references.get.description: Tool to retrieve references to a specific entry in Contentful. Use when you need to find all entries that reference a particular entry. The include parameter controls how many levels of nested references are returned.

entries.snapshots.list.title: Get Entry Snapshots
entries.snapshots.list.description: Tool to get all snapshots of an entry in Contentful. Use when you need to retrieve the history of changes made to an entry.

environments.get.title: Get Environment
environments.get.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific environment by its ID within a space. Use when you need information about a single environment in Contentful.

organizations.get.title: Get Organization
organizations.get.description: Retrieves details of a specific organization by its ID. Use this when you need to get information about an organization that an admin or owner has access to.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Get Organization.

organizations.access_grants.get.title: Get Organization Access Grant
organizations.access_grants.get.description: Retrieves the access grant status for a specific organization. Use this to verify whether the authenticated user has access to a specific organization.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Get Organization Access Grant.

organizations.list.title: Get Organizations
organizations.list.description: Tool to get all organizations an account has access to in Contentful. Use when you need to list available organizations for the authenticated user.

organizations.ai_providers.list.title: Get Organizations AI Providers
organizations.ai_providers.list.description: Retrieves all AI providers configured for an organization in Contentful. Use this to list AI service providers (OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Gemini, etc.) that have been configured for the organization.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Get Organizations AI Providers.

organizations.app_action_categories.list.title: Get Organization App Actions Categories
organizations.app_action_categories.list.description: Retrieves app action categories for a Contentful organization. Use this to discover available app action categories and their parameters.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Get Organization App Actions Categories.

app_definitions.event_subscriptions.get.title: Get App Event Subscription
app_definitions.event_subscriptions.get.description: Tool to retrieve details of an app event subscription by organization and app definition ID. Use when you need to check the configuration of event subscriptions for an app.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Get App Event Subscription.

appDefinitionId.description: appDefinitionId for Get App Event Subscription.

app_definitions.list.title: Get Organizations App Definitions
app_definitions.list.description: Retrieves all app definitions for a specific organization. Use when you need to list or discover apps owned by an organization.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Get Organizations App Definitions.

app_definitions.access_grants.list.title: Get Organizations App Definitions Access Grants
app_definitions.access_grants.list.description: Get all app access grants for a specific app definition within an organization. Use when you need to list which organizations can install a specific app definition.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Get Organizations App Definitions Access Grants.

appDefinitionId.description: appDefinitionId for Get Organizations App Definitions Access Grants.

app_definitions.actions.list.title: Get App Definition Actions
app_definitions.actions.list.description: Tool to get all actions of an app definition within an organization. Use when you need to retrieve the list of actions defined for a specific Contentful app.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Get App Definition Actions.

appDefinitionId.description: appDefinitionId for Get App Definition Actions.

app_definitions.actions.get.title: Get App Action Details
app_definitions.actions.get.description: Tool to read a specific app action from an app definition within an organization. Use when you need to retrieve details of a particular action defined for a Contentful app.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Get App Action Details.

appDefinitionId.description: appDefinitionId for Get App Action Details.

appActionId.description: appActionId for Get App Action Details.

app_definitions.bundles.list.title: Get App Definition App Bundles
app_definitions.bundles.list.description: Tool to get all app bundles for a specific app definition within an organization. Use when you need to list all uploaded bundles for a Contentful app.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Get App Definition App Bundles.

appDefinitionId.description: appDefinitionId for Get App Definition App Bundles.

app_definitions.functions.list.title: Get App Definition Functions
app_definitions.functions.list.description: Tool to get all functions of an app definition within an organization. Use when you need to retrieve the list of functions defined for a specific Contentful app.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Get App Definition Functions.

appDefinitionId.description: appDefinitionId for Get App Definition Functions.

app_definitions.keys.list.title: Get App Definition Keys
app_definitions.keys.list.description: Tool to retrieve all app keys for a specific app definition in a Contentful organization. Use when you need to list cryptographic keys for app authentication.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Get App Definition Keys.

appDefinitionId.description: appDefinitionId for Get App Definition Keys.

app_definitions.signing_secret.get.title: Get App Definition Signing Secret
app_definitions.signing_secret.get.description: Tool to retrieve the current app signing secret for an app definition. Use when you need to verify the existence or view the last 4 characters of a signing secret. Note: Full secret is only available at creation time.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Get App Definition Signing Secret.

appDefinitionId.description: appDefinitionId for Get App Definition Signing Secret.

organizations.enablements.get.title: Get Organization Enablements
organizations.enablements.get.description: Retrieves feature enablements for a specific organization in Contentful. Use this to check which AI and vectorization features are enabled for the organization.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Get Organization Enablements.

organizations.invitations.get.title: Get Organization Invitation
organizations.invitations.get.description: Retrieves a single invitation for an organization (alpha). Use this to get details about a specific invitation including invitee information and status. Note: This endpoint is in alpha state and may be subject to breaking changes.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Get Organization Invitation.

organizations.periodic_usages.list.title: Get Organization Periodic Usages
organizations.periodic_usages.list.description: Tool to get organization periodic usage statistics. Use when you need to retrieve API usage metrics for an organization during a specific time period, with optional filtering by metric type and date range.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Get Organization Periodic Usages.

organizations.roles.list.title: Get Organization Roles
organizations.roles.list.description: Retrieves all space roles in an organization. Use this to list roles that define user permissions and access levels within an organization's spaces.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Get Organization Roles.

organizations.security_contacts.list.title: Get Organization Security Contacts
organizations.security_contacts.list.description: Retrieves security contacts for a specific organization that an admin or owner has access to. Use this to get the list of security contacts configured for an organization.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Get Organization Security Contacts.

organizations.space_enablements.list.title: Get Organizations Space Enablements
organizations.space_enablements.list.description: Retrieves all space enablements for a specific organization. Use when you need to check which features are enabled for spaces within an organization.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Get Organizations Space Enablements.

organizations.space_periodic_usages.list.title: Get Organizations Space Periodic Usages
organizations.space_periodic_usages.list.description: Tool to retrieve space periodic usage data for an organization. Use this when you need to analyze usage metrics, monitor API consumption, or track resource utilization over time.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Get Organizations Space Periodic Usages.

taxonomy.concepts.list.title: Get Organizations Taxonomy Concepts
taxonomy.concepts.list.description: Retrieves all taxonomy concepts for an organization in Contentful. Use this to list concepts that can be used to classify and organize content within the organization.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Get Organizations Taxonomy Concepts.

taxonomy.concepts.ancestors.list.title: Get Taxonomy Concept Ancestors
taxonomy.concepts.ancestors.list.description: Retrieves the list of ancestor concepts for a specific taxonomy concept. Use this when you need to understand the hierarchical lineage of a concept in the taxonomy structure.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Get Taxonomy Concept Ancestors.

conceptId.description: conceptId for Get Taxonomy Concept Ancestors.

taxonomy.concept_schemes.list.title: Get Organizations Taxonomy Concept Schemes
taxonomy.concept_schemes.list.description: Tool to retrieve all taxonomy concept schemes from an organization. Use when you need to list or discover the taxonomy structure and concept schemes available in an organization.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Get Organizations Taxonomy Concept Schemes.

taxonomy.concept_schemes.get.title: Get Taxonomy Concept Scheme
taxonomy.concept_schemes.get.description: Tool to retrieve a specific taxonomy concept scheme from an organization. Use when you need to get detailed information about a taxonomy concept scheme including its concepts, labels, and definitions.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Get Taxonomy Concept Scheme.

conceptSchemeId.description: conceptSchemeId for Get Taxonomy Concept Scheme.

taxonomy.concept_schemes.total.get.title: Get Organizations Taxonomy Concept Schemes Total
taxonomy.concept_schemes.total.get.description: Retrieves the total count of taxonomy concept schemes for a specific organization. Use this when you need to get the number of concept schemes configured for an organization's taxonomy.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Get Organizations Taxonomy Concept Schemes Total.

taxonomy.concepts.total.get.title: Get Organizations Taxonomy Concepts Total
taxonomy.concepts.total.get.description: Retrieves the total count of taxonomy concepts for a specific organization. Use this when you need to get the number of concepts configured for an organization's taxonomy.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Get Organizations Taxonomy Concepts Total.

releases.get.title: Get Release
releases.get.description: Tool to get a single release by ID from Contentful. Use when you need to retrieve details about a specific release including its entities, metadata, and archive status.

spaces.get.title: Get space
spaces.get.description: Retrieves metadata of a specific space by its ID. Returns space-level details only (name, locales, sys fields) — not entries, content types, or assets. The returned sys.version is required for subsequent CONTENTFUL_UPDATE_SPACE calls to avoid version conflict errors.

space_memberships.list.title: Get Space Memberships
space_memberships.list.description: Tool to get all space memberships in a Contentful space. Use when you need to list all users who have access to a space and their assigned roles. Returns paginated results with membership details including admin status and role assignments.

api_keys.list.title: Get Delivery API Keys
api_keys.list.description: Tool to retrieve all Delivery API keys for a specific Contentful space. Use when you need to list all API keys configured for content delivery. This action returns key details including name, access token, policies, and associated environments.

spaceId.description: spaceId for Get Delivery API Keys.

app_installations.list.title: List App Installations
app_installations.list.description: Lists all app installations in a specific Contentful environment. Use this to discover which apps are currently installed in an environment.

assets.list.title: Get All Assets
assets.list.description: Retrieves all assets from a specific environment in a Contentful space. Use this to list and browse assets like images, videos, and documents. Supports pagination and ordering for large asset collections.

locales.list.title: Get Space Environment Locales
locales.list.description: Tool to retrieve all locales of a space environment in Contentful. Use when you need to list all available locales including their codes, names, default status, and fallback configurations.

spaceId.description: spaceId for Get Space Environment Locales.

environmentId.description: environmentId for Get Space Environment Locales.

app_installations.functions.list.title: Get App Installation Functions
app_installations.functions.list.description: Tool to get all functions for an app installation in a Contentful environment. Use when you need to retrieve the list of functions defined for an installed app in a specific space and environment.

spaceId.description: spaceId for Get App Installation Functions.

environmentId.description: environmentId for Get App Installation Functions.

appInstallationId.description: appInstallationId for Get App Installation Functions.

webhooks.get.title: Get Webhook
webhooks.get.description: Tool to retrieve a single webhook definition from a Contentful space. Use this action when you need to inspect the configuration details of an existing webhook, including its URL, subscribed topics, headers, and filters. The webhook definition contains all configuration needed for Contentful to send webhook notifications to external systems.

webhooks.calls.list.title: Get Webhook Calls
webhooks.calls.list.description: Tool to retrieve an overview of recent webhook calls for a specific webhook in Contentful. Use this action when you need to inspect webhook call history, debug webhook issues, or monitor webhook performance and reliability. The response includes request/response details, timestamps, status codes, and any errors that occurred.

webhooks.health.get.title: Get Webhook Health
webhooks.health.get.description: Retrieves health status and call statistics for a specific webhook in Contentful. Use this action when you need to monitor webhook performance, check success rates, or troubleshoot webhook delivery issues.

roles.list.title: Get All Space Roles
roles.list.description: Tool to retrieve all roles from a Contentful space. Use this to list roles that define user permissions and access levels within a space.

spaceId.description: spaceId for Get All Space Roles.

webhooks.list.title: List Space Webhooks
webhooks.list.description: Retrieves all webhooks configured for a Contentful space. Webhooks enable real-time notifications when content changes occur. Use this action when you need to view existing webhook configurations, audit webhook subscriptions, or check which events are being monitored.

assets.process.title: Process Asset
assets.process.description: Tool to process an asset file in Contentful for a specific locale. Use this action when you need to trigger asset processing after uploading a file. Processing downloads the file from the provided URL, validates it, and makes it available through Contentful's CDN. After processing completes, the asset can be published to make it publicly accessible.

assets.publish.title: Publish Asset
assets.publish.description: Tool to publish an asset in Contentful, making it available via the Content Delivery API. Use when you need to make an asset publicly accessible or move it from draft to published status. The asset must not be archived and should be fully processed before publishing. Publishing increments the asset version and sets publication metadata.

entries.publish.title: Publish Entry
entries.publish.description: Tool to publish an entry in Contentful, making it available via the Content Delivery API. Use when you need to make an entry publicly accessible or move it from draft to published status. The entry must not be archived and should have all required fields completed. Publishing increments the entry version.

assets.queryCollection.title: Query Asset Collection
assets.queryCollection.description: Tool to retrieve multiple assets with pagination and filtering via GraphQL API. Use when you need to query assets from Contentful with advanced filtering, sorting, and locale selection. Supports preview mode and fallback locale options.

useFallbackLocale.description: Whether missing locale values fall back.

graphql.query.title: Query GraphQL Content Type Collection
graphql.query.description: Tool to query a collection of entries for a specific content type using GraphQL. Use when you need to fetch multiple entries with filtering, sorting, pagination, or preview mode. The query field name must be the camelCase content type ID with 'Collection' suffix (e.g., 'blogPostCollection').

spaceId.description: spaceId for Query GraphQL Content Type Collection.

query.description: GraphQL query string for a *Collection field.

entries.unarchive.title: Unarchive Entry
entries.unarchive.description: Tool to unarchive an entry in Contentful, restoring it to active status. Use when you need to restore an archived entry to make it available for editing and publishing. The entry must be currently archived. You may need to provide the X-Contentful-Version header matching the entry's current version.

content_types.unpublish.title: Unpublish Content Type
content_types.unpublish.description: Unpublishes a content type in Contentful, removing it from the Content Delivery API. Use this action when you need to take a content type offline while keeping it in draft state for further modifications. Once unpublished, entries of this type will no longer be accessible via the delivery API, but can still be edited in the management interface. Requires the current version number for optimistic locking.

version.description: Content type version sent as X-Contentful-Version.

app_definitions.update.title: Update App Definition
app_definitions.update.description: Tool to update an app definition by ID in a Contentful organization. Use when you need to modify an app's name, source URL, locations, or parameters.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Update App Definition.

appDefinitionId.description: appDefinitionId for Update App Definition.

content_types.update.title: Update Content Type
content_types.update.description: Updates an existing content type in a Contentful environment. Use when you need to modify a content type's name, description, display field, or field definitions. Requires the current version number for optimistic locking. The API does not merge partial updates - you must provide the complete content type definition including all existing fields.

version.description: Content type version sent as X-Contentful-Version.

editor_interfaces.update.title: Update Editor Interface
editor_interfaces.update.description: Tool to update the editor interface configuration for a content type. Use when you need to customize how fields are displayed and edited in the Contentful UI. The version number is required to prevent conflicts when multiple users update the same editor interface.

version.description: Editor interface version sent as X-Contentful-Version.

controls.description: Widget controls for content type fields.

entries.update.title: Update Entry
entries.update.description: Tool to create or update an entry in a Contentful space environment. Use when you need to modify entry content or create a new entry with a specific ID. Requires the content type ID, entry version for updates, and field values organized by locale.

contentType.description: Content type id sent as X-Contentful-Content-Type.

locales.update.title: Update Locale
locales.update.description: Updates an existing locale in a Contentful environment. Use this action when you need to modify locale properties such as name, code, fallback settings, or API availability flags. Requires the current version number for optimistic locking to prevent concurrent modifications.

optional.description: Whether this locale is optional for publishing.

contentDeliveryApi.description: Whether the locale is available on CDA.

contentManagementApi.description: Whether the locale is available on CMA.

app_definitions.event_subscriptions.upda.title: Update App Event Subscription
app_definitions.event_subscriptions.upda.description: Tool to update or create an app event subscription in a Contentful organization. Use when you need to configure event subscriptions for an app definition to receive webhooks.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Update App Event Subscription.

appDefinitionId.description: appDefinitionId for Update App Event Subscription.

targetUrl.description: HTTPS URL that receives app events.

app_definitions.actions.update.title: Update App Definition Action
app_definitions.actions.update.description: Tool to update an action for a Contentful app definition. Use when you need to modify existing action properties such as name, URL, type, or category.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Update App Definition Action.

appDefinitionId.description: appDefinitionId for Update App Definition Action.

appActionId.description: appActionId for Update App Definition Action.

app_definitions.details.update.title: Update App Definition Details
app_definitions.details.update.description: Tool to create or update app definition details for an organization in Contentful. Use when you need to initialize or modify app details such as icons or preview images. Note: This endpoint accepts an empty body to initialize details; properties like 'name' and 'src' are not accepted here and will cause validation errors.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Update App Definition Details.

appDefinitionId.description: appDefinitionId for Update App Definition Details.

app_definitions.signing_secret.update.title: Update App Definition Signing Secret
app_definitions.signing_secret.update.description: Tool to create or overwrite the app signing secret for an app definition. Use when you need to set up webhook signature verification or rotate an existing secret. Note: This operation overwrites any existing signing secret.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Update App Definition Signing Secret.

appDefinitionId.description: appDefinitionId for Update App Definition Signing Secret.

organizations.enablements.update.title: Update Organization Enablements
organizations.enablements.update.description: Updates feature enablements for a specific organization in Contentful. Use this to enable or disable AI and vectorization features for the organization. Requires the current version number for optimistic locking to prevent conflicts.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Update Organization Enablements.

organizations.security_contacts.update.title: Update Organization Security Contact
organizations.security_contacts.update.description: Updates an organization security contact that an admin or owner has access to. Use this to change the email address of a security contact.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Update Organization Security Contact.

securityId.description: securityId for Update Organization Security Contact.

taxonomy.concepts.update.title: Update Organizations Taxonomy Concepts
taxonomy.concepts.update.description: Tool to create or update a taxonomy concept with a user-defined ID in a Contentful organization. Use when you need to create a concept with a specific ID or update an existing concept's properties.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Update Organizations Taxonomy Concepts.

conceptId.description: conceptId for Update Organizations Taxonomy Concepts.

hiddenLabels.description: Hidden search labels keyed by locale.

taxonomy.concept_schemes.update.title: Update Organizations Taxonomy Concept Schemes
taxonomy.concept_schemes.update.description: Tool to create or update a taxonomy concept scheme with a user-defined ID in an organization. Use when you need to create a new classification scheme or update an existing one with localized labels and definitions.

organizationId.description: organizationId for Update Organizations Taxonomy Concept Schemes.

conceptSchemeId.description: conceptSchemeId for Update Organizations Taxonomy Concept Schemes.

spaces.update.title: Update space
spaces.update.description: Updates the name of a specific space. Notes: - The version number is required to ensure you're updating the latest version of the space. - You can get the current version from the sys.version field when fetching space details. - Only the name of the space can be updated.

tags.update.title: Update Tag
tags.update.description: Creates or updates a tag in a Contentful environment. Use this when you need to modify an existing tag's name or create a new one.

sys.description: Tag sys metadata including id and type.

webhooks.update.title: Update Webhook
webhooks.update.description: Updates an existing webhook definition in a Contentful space. Use this action when you need to modify webhook configuration such as the target URL, event topics, custom headers, filters, or authentication settings. Contentful uses optimistic locking via the version parameter or X-Contentful-Version header to prevent concurrent modification conflicts.

bulk_actions.validate.title: Validate Bulk Action
bulk_actions.validate.description: Tool to validate a bulk action before executing it. Use when you need to check if multiple entries or assets can be published in bulk without actually publishing them. This helps identify potential issues before attempting the actual bulk operation.

users.me.title: Get authenticated user
users.me.description: Retrieve the Contentful user bound to the CMA token (GET /users/me).

environments.create.auto.title: Create Environment With Generated Id
environments.create.auto.description: Create an environment with an auto-generated sys.id. POST https://api.contentful.com/spaces/{space_id}/environments. Optional X-Contentful-Source-Environment clones another environment. Specified ids use environments.create.

source_environment_id.description: Optional source environment id sent as X-Contentful-Source-Environment.

content_types.snapshots.get.environment.title: Get Content Type Snapshot By Environment
content_types.snapshots.get.environment.description: Get one content type snapshot. GET https://api.contentful.com/spaces/{space_id}/environments/{environment_id}/content_types/{content_type_id}/snapshots/{snapshot_id}. Contentful documents snapshots for the master environment.

organizations.access_grant.get.title: Get Organization Access Grant Status
organizations.access_grant.get.description: Verify whether the token has access to an organization. GET https://api.contentful.com/organizations/{organization_id}/access_grant. This is the singular route, not /access_grants.

organizations.app_actions_categories.lis.title: List App Actions Categories
organizations.app_actions_categories.lis.description: List app action categories for an organization. GET https://api.contentful.com/organizations/{organization_id}/app_actions_categories.
